external_transfer.claim_boundary: This validates a deterministic host authority boundary against InjecAgent-labeled attacker action proposals; it does not measure whether an LLM itself resists or detects prompt injection.

protected_lineage.execution: clean GitHub hosted runner, grouped parent gates

readiness.kind: internal Coding-AGI engineering-readiness; not AGI probability

world.claim_boundary: ACCEPTED_BOUNDED_CAPABILITY only; World W5 non-convergence is preserved.
critical_unknowns: Semantic prompt-injection detection is not proven; the authority boundary constrains consequences even if the model follows malicious text.
Source reliability and Sybil-family attribution remain heuristic and can be wrong under coordinated independent-looking sources.
Challenge suites may be incomplete or correlated with the acquired procedure.
Rollback is proven for ExternalWorkingState only; arbitrary irreversible external I/O requires host sandboxing/compensation.
Distillation is bounded by the registered primitive vocabulary and does not prove open-ended reasoning-operator invention.
The authored poison benchmark is bounded; InjecAgent transfer validates labeled action containment rather than end-to-end autonomous coding-agent robustness.
